procedure.prepare: Parent gathers and independently verifies every prerequisite above. Stop before Start while any is absent, stale or contradictory. Use existing owners for host/consumer/grant preparation; do not run a live operation from this file.
procedure.select: Record exact Bifrost repository, immutable consumer SHA, main base/SHA, distinct pinned hub workflow SHA/artifact manifest, hub Issue/node/body/AC hashes, destination host/system/channel/checkout/worktree/branch/run, finite concrete regular docs/*.md files, verification checks/profile, policies, credential references/generations and optional admitted parent target. Record permitted effects explicitly: repository_worktree, issue_claim, publication, review_merge, closure_reconciliation; parent evidence only if separately present in both approval and policy. No provider/tenant platform, repo creation, policy/grant/bootstrap changes or root README.
procedure.preview: Use the authenticated production issue_delivery_preview and inspect exact source/policy/credential identities. Re-read independent source authority and required recovery proof. Any changed source, policy, base, epoch, expiry, claim or credential invalidates this preview; reapprove only after reconciliation.
procedure.start: Only the selected human may confirm the exact manifest through issue_delivery_start. Record approval ID/hash, authority epoch, operation key, source pair and decision receipt. A read-only acknowledgement, model proposal, test pass or this plan cannot supply Start.
procedure.observe: Admit the exact native task through admit_issue_delivery_task, use the production IssueDeliveryOperationAdapter/protected executor and preserve reservation, attempt, entry/session and effect-slot identities. Observe after owner UI disconnect using server readback; do not create a replacement launch on ambiguity.
procedure.reconcile: On drift, interruption or unknown effect stop further effects and use the previously qualified operation-specific recovery path. Preserve original approval and completed effects. Re-read outbox/destination/GitHub before retry; never mint another key/attempt to erase uncertainty. Unsupported launcher stop remains a limitation, not confirmation that the operation stopped.
procedure.readback: Independently read consumer PR/head/full base-to-head tree diff, all old/new rename/copy paths and modes/blobs, checks/reviews/merge, exact hub Issue closure and owner-doc result. Use read_issue_delivery_projection with production GitHub authority and authenticated API/outbox readers. Worker text, Git commits made by a fixture, matching hashes alone or a closed issue are insufficient. Preserve mismatched/stale/unavailable evidence as incomplete.
procedure.try: Obtain the production FCA-09-BIFROST exact git_documentation readiness binding from independently read protected policy/source/blobs/access and current profile. Let the authorized human inspect that exact documentation candidate and explicitly record tried/not-tried. Image/VM readiness, automated observation and M1 acknowledgement cannot supply the trial.
procedure.accept: The same admitted human explicitly accepts or rejects the exact current candidate/profile with current trial lineage through existing outcome authority. Re-read correction/withdrawal/history. Record result and residual limits on parent #5399; a successful bounded documentation candidate does not close full platform acceptance. Leave this preparation receipt incomplete; retain real authenticated receipts under their existing owners.
